subject: Next steps & success criteria — deployment mode check-in for ClearPath Health
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Torres <sofia.torres@clearpathhealth.com>, Patrick O'Neil <patrick.oneil@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & success criteria — deployment mode check-in for ClearPath Health

Hi Sofia / Patrick —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared checklist to land on deployment mode for the proof-of-concept (PoC):

Quick recap
- Primary goal: embed Redwood for clinical note generation & triage in the ClearPath intake flow (PHI in transit).
- Key constraints: data residency in US, SOC2 & HIPAA considerations, predictable latency for short-requests (<=200ms p95).
- Current leaning: Security is pushing toward a Private VPC/on-prem option but product wants to understand trade-offs for Dedicated (reserved capacity) and Hosted API as a faster path to iterate.

Immediate asks / decision items
1) Confirm which deployment modes you're willing to pilot for PoC: Hosted API (fastest), Dedicated (predictable throughput), Private VPC / on-prem (compliance).
2) Identify stakeholders to include for a short alignment call: security, infra (network), product owner, and a dev who will integrate the SDK.
3) Agree success criteria and a target timeline for the PoC run. I suggested below a pragmatic plan for each mode.

Proposed PoC options & timelines (high-level)
- Hosted API (minimal infra): 2-week trial, success = end-to-end integration + latency <250ms p95, no PHI persisted on our side.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity in Redwood-managed infra): 4-week trial, success = sustained throughput 10 req/s, latency <200ms p95, cost envelope agreed.
- Private VPC / on-prem: 6–8 week onboarding, success = SSO/KMS integration, audit logs in customer's SIEM, SOC2/HIPAA checklist satisfied.

Suggested success criteria (draft)
- Functional: integration passes 5 canonical prompts, model responses meet QA threshold (F1>=0.78 on eval set).
- Performance: latency and throughput targets above.
- Security/compliance: clearance from ClearPath security on network & data flow, signed DPA, and required SOC2 evidence uploaded.

Next steps I propose
- Sofia: confirm preferred PoC mode(s) and list of stakeholders by EOD Monday.
- Patrick: share a point-of-contact for infra/network and the preferred time to review the network diagram.
- Monica/Neha: I'll loop you in internally to own technical and security pre-checks.

Attachments: I attached a short SOW draft and a checklist for PoC acceptance criteria for your review.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min sync if useful.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Thanks Marcus — useful summary. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Security preference: our security/compliance team is strongly recommending Private VPC for any workload touching PHI. That said, product is open to a quick Hosted API sandbox to validate model quality on de-identified data first.

2) Stakeholders:
- Patrick O'Neil — Sr. DevOps (network/VPC) — will own infra onboarding
- Dr. Amir Shah — Product lead (clinical triage) — will own acceptance criteria
- Me (Sofia) — program owner
- CC: our InfoSec reviewer (we'll add them soon)

3) Timeline: we have a board review on Oct 7 and would like some demonstration material by Oct 3. Does the 6–8 week Private timeline allow enough time? If not, the hybrid path (Hosted sandbox -> Private cutover) might be our go-to.

Can you provide a rough cost delta between Dedicated and Private (ballpark %) and a short checklist of what we need for the VPC peering? I'll pull our infra people and propose times for a 30-min network sync next week.

Appreciate the attachments — I'll review and share our security reviewer feedback.

Sofia

Thanks Marcus — I can own the technical plan. Notes below after a quick tech read:

Technical PoC runbook (high level)
- Phase A: Hosted sandbox (2 weeks)
  - Tasks: SDK integration using de-identified payloads, smoke tests for 5 canonical prompts, basic telemetry and logging to validate request/response shapes.
  - Deliverable: recorded demo + latency/quality screenshot pack.
- Phase B: Private onboarding (6 weeks, overlap with Phase A)
  - Tasks: VPC peer setup, route tables, firewall rules, NAT Gateway config (if required), certificates for mTLS, KMS integration for encryption-at-rest keys, SSO configuration (SAML/OIDC), and log forwarder to customer's SIEM.
  - Deliverable: deployment checklist + audit logs showing model inference events.

Prerequisites we need from ClearPath
- VPC CIDR ranges and a contact for the network team.
- Allowlist IP ranges (we'll provide) or set up VPC peering.
- KMS key admin rights for the test environment (or a test key).
- A safe test dataset (de-identified) and feature flags for dev environment.

Estimated effort & timing to support Oct 3 demo
- If we start Phase A this week and ClearPath provides de-id data and a test infra contact within 48 hours, we can produce a demo build by Oct 1.
- Private cutover by Oct 3 is aggressive unless ClearPath already has network approvals; I'd calendar for Oct 15 for production-like Private demo. Suggest hybrid: Hosted sandbox demo Oct 1–3, Private cutover target Oct 15.

Attachment: network-diagram.png (sample of typical VPC layout we use for private deployments).

I'll draft the runbook + test-cases and share by EOD today.

—Monica

Looping in a few security pre-check items so ClearPath knows what we'll need to move Private forward: 

Security pre-check list (high priority)
- SOC2 Type II report (latest) and any HIPAA attestation language.
- Data flow diagram showing how PHI traverses systems (we'll provide a template).
- Retention & deletion policy for inference logs; explicit S3 lifecycle policy recommended.
- KMS & key rotation policy; confirm whether customer-managed keys (BYOK) are required.
- SSO details (SAML metadata) and SCIM if they want provisioning.
- Network: required inbound/outbound ports, support for mTLS, and SIEM log forwarder endpoint.

I'll also schedule a 30-min call with our security enablement engineer to walk ClearPath through the checklist and sample evidence (SOC2 excerpts, encryption architecture). Proposed times: Tue 9/22 10:00am PT or Wed 9/23 2:00pm PT — please let us know what works.

One more note on timelines: the SOC2 evidence review can often be parallelized with Phase A; however, any remediations identified could delay Private cutover. We'll flag items early.

—Neha Kapoor
